'''Richard M. Pollack''' (January 25, 1935&nbsp;–&nbsp;September 18, 2018<ref>{{Cite web | url=https://proutfuneralhome.com/obituary/richard-m-pollack-phd/ | title=Richard M. Pollack |website=Prout Funeral Home |accessdate=November 17, 2021}}</ref><ref>"[https://sympa.inria.fr/sympa/arc/compgeom-announce/2018-09/msg00005.html Ricky Pollack]", sent by [[Joseph S. B. Mitchell]] on behalf of the Computational Geometry steering committee to the compgeom-announce mailing list, September 19, 2018</ref>) was an American [[geometer]] who spent most of his career at the [[Courant Institute of Mathematical Sciences]] at [[New York University]], where he was Professor Emeritus until his death.

of the [[Hadwiger transversal theorem]] to higher dimensions.<ref name="hadwiger" /> He and Goodman were the founding editors of the journal ''[[Discrete & Computational Geometry]]''.<ref>{{Cite web | url=https://www.springer.com/journal/454/editors | title=Discrete & Computational Geometry | website=[[Discrete & Computational Geometry]] | publisher=[[Springer Science+Business Media]] | accessdate=November 17, 2021 | archive-date=April 14, 2020 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200414164711/https://www.springer.com/journal/454/editors | url-status=dead }}</ref>

In [[real algebraic geometry]], Pollack wrote a series of papers with [[Saugata Basu]] and [[Marie-Françoise Roy]],<ref name="basu0" /><ref name="basu1" /><ref name="basu2" /><ref name="basu3" /> as well as a book.<ref>{{citation
|first1=Saugata|last1=Basu

|title=Algorithms in Real Algebraic Geometry
|publisher=Springer-Verlag
|series=Algorithms and Computation in Mathematics
|volume=10
|year=2003}}</ref>

==Awards and honors==
In 2003, a collection of original research papers in [[discrete geometry|discrete]] and [[computational geometry]] entitled ''Discrete and Computational Geometry: The Goodman–Pollack Festschrift'' was published as a tribute to Jacob E. Goodman and Richard Pollack on the occasion of their 2/3&nbsp;×&nbsp;100 birthdays.<ref>{{Cite book | url=https://www.springer.com/mathematics/geometry/book/978-3-540-00371-7 | isbn=9783540003717| title=Discrete and Computational Geometry: The Goodman-Pollack Festschrift| publisher=Springer| year=2003| series=Algorithms and Combinatorics}}</ref>

In 2012, he became a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>[https://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society], retrieved 2013-05-26.</ref>

A special memorial 556-page issue of ''[[Discrete & Computational Geometry]]'' for Pollack was published in October 2020.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Discrete & Computational Geometry {{!}} Volume 64, issue 3|url=https://link.springer.com/journal/454/volumes-and-issues/64-3|access-date=2020-11-26|website=SpringerLink|language=en}}</ref>
